# inner automorphism　`def.inner-automorphism`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.inner-automorphism)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.inner-automorphism.md)

⭐ Examples: the inner automorphisms of $S_n$ are exactly the conjugations preserving cycle type; the inner automorphisms of $GL_n(K)$ are $A \mapsto P A P^{-1}$.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
